scripts.build:staging: cross-env CLOUDFLARE_ENV=staging WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/logs/wrangler.log vite build --mode cloudflare-staging && node scripts/verify-deployment-config.mjs validate-build staging
scripts.build:production: cross-env CLOUDFLARE_ENV=production WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/logs/wrangler.log vite build --mode cloudflare-production && node scripts/verify-deployment-config.mjs validate-build production
scripts.test:coverage: pnpm run test -- --coverage && pnpm run test:worker -- --coverage && pnpm run test:worker:configured -- --coverage
scripts.check: pnpm run config:verify && pnpm run assets:verify && pnpm run types:check && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint && pnpm run test:coverage && pnpm run test:e2e && pnpm run build:budgets && pnpm run check:startup
scripts.deploy:staging: node scripts/verify-deployment-config.mjs validate-env staging .env.staging && pnpm run check && pnpm run build:staging && cross-env WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/logs/wrangler.log wrangler deploy --secrets-file .env.staging
scripts.deploy:production: node scripts/verify-deployment-config.mjs validate-env production .env.production && pnpm run check && pnpm run build:production && cross-env WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/logs/wrangler.log wrangler deploy --secrets-file .env.production
